mentions.name: ToneDiff
mentions.description: This web app enables instant A/B comparison testing of audio gear. It offers two modes: uploading custom audio files with basic analytics (waveform and spectrum views), and YouTube video-based virtual tracks that eliminate long timeline scrubbing. Planned features include blind testing, match mode, and user track reordering.
mentions.problem: Choosing speakers, mics, or guitar pickups meant juggling dozens of YouTube tabs and endless scrubbing to compare gear sounds.
mentions.audience: People choosing audio equipment such as speakers, microphones, and guitar pickups
